name: ux2-u12-queuecard
prompt: In public/js/main.js, function cardInner(job) (STU-UX2: the queue on each card). queue.js defines the globals queueInfoHtml(job) and shortReason(text). Two changes, one SEARCH/REPLACE each; change nothing else: 1. In the line that builds the thumbnail div (it contains `${media}${job.status === 'running' || job.status === 'queued' ? ringHtml(job.progress) : ''}`), add `${queueInfoHtml(job)}` right after the ringHtml part, still inside the div. 2. Failed and cancelled jobs: after the `if (job.status === 'running' || job.status === 'queued') { actions = iconBtn('cancel', ...); }` branch, add a new branch `else if (job.status === 'error' || job.status === 'cancelled')` that sets actions to: for an error, `SHORT` where FULL is escapeHtml(job.error || '') and SHORT is escapeHtml(shortReason(job.error)); then iconBtn('retry', 'Retry', `data-id="${escapeHtml(job.promptId)}"`, 'accent') and iconBtn('delete', 'Delete', `data-id="${escapeHtml(job.promptId)}"`, 'danger'). Also add two entries to the ICON object: retry: '' and delete: '' (that is a third SEARCH/REPLACE, on the line `cancel: '',`).
